verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own router skill that sends any gstack request to the right skill, plus documented natural-language and voice trigger phrases such as "test the app" and "run QA" that invoke skills. It can also turn vague intent into an executable spec, so users operate it through plain-language requests inside their agent host. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the router interprets free-form requests and how widely trigger phrases cover the other skills, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language invocation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Sends any gstack request to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design).
Voice triggers (speech-to-text aliases): "quality check", "test the app", "run QA".
Turn vague intent into a precise, executable spec in five phases.
